text:
neha: kicked off phased promotion for model v12-4bit at 10:20 PT (PhaseGate). quick A/B at 2% traffic revealed a measurable drop on the long-summary slice: -2.9% ROUGE-L vs v11 baseline. overall latency/cost are in line.
tom: thx. what's the slice sample size at 2%? could be stochastic.
neha: long-summary n=2.8k, other slices (short_q, rerank) n>20k and stable.
rita: 2.9% ROUGE-L drop on long-summary is borderline. Our current PhaseGate rule is flat threshold 3% for any slice. That would have passed, but product flagged long-summaries as sensitive.
jorge: any token-divergence or length changes? could be tokenization/early-stop in int4 path.
neha: quick metrics: token-delta +0.2 tokens avg, early-termination count +0.6% absolute, prefix-consistency -1.1% (we track alignment where model outputs prefix of baseline).
rita: early-termination increase is concerning for summaries. Might be beam/stop-token behavior under quant noise.
qa-bot: regression alert: PG-1738891111 summary-rouge breach detected.
tom: let's freeze ramp. Manual policy: if any product-sensitive slice >1.5% regress we stop. This is at 2.9% so abort.
deploy-bot: initiating rollback to v11-fp16 per eng-ml request (user=neha)
neha: rollback done. planning next steps: 1) run 500k shadow evals on long-summary slice with identical batching/prefetch semantics to prod; 2) collect token-alignment heatmap and early-stop trigger logs; 3) try 2 experiments: a) int4 with fp16 KV cache, b) int4 with adjusted stop-token threshold (+1 token).
jorge: add qualitative diff of 100 random regressions and 100 worst regressions. flag hallucination vs omission.
rita: propose PhaseGate config augmentation: per-slice normalized weights + cooldown window + auto-fallback suppression for transient noise. draft snippet: 
```
"phasegate": {
  "slices": [
    {"name": "long_summary", "weight": 3, "max_rel_regress": 1.5},
    {"name": "short_q", "weight": 1, "max_rel_regress": 5.0},
    {"name": "rerank", "weight": 1, "max_rel_regress": 3.0}
  ],
  "normalize_weights": true,
  "cooldown_min": 10,
  "auto_fallback": true,
  "pager_threshold_min": 15
}
```
neha: suggestion: normalize_weights=true should compute normalized = weight / sum(weights). Also pager_threshold_min = minutes a breach must persist before paging. Good.
tom: we should also add a sample-size sanity check: require min_n per slice (e.g., min_n_long_summary=2k) before considering the metric stable. If n < min_n, mark as noisy and hold.
rita: added to runbook. Also adding a safety-multiplier: product-sensitive slices get a multiplier on max_rel_regress (i.e., effective_threshold = max_rel_regress / multiplier). For long_summary multiplier=1.5 -> effective threshold smaller.
jorge: plan for experiments: I'll queue the 500k shadow runs with two variants (fp16-KV vs alt-stop). Expect ~4h.
neha: I'll open a PR for PhaseGate config + runbook changes. Assign to @tom for min_n thresholds and @rita for multiplier rules.
tom: assigned, will review PR and add unit tests for normalization math.
qa-bot: shadow job queued id=sj_1738891111 variants=2 expected_finish=4h
neha: thanks. reminder: even though int4 gives 20% infra savings, we must not degrade summarization quality. hold until experiments confirm parity.
rita: agreed. we'll reconvene after shadow results. closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
